top_signals.title: Dollar Gains as US Plan to Cut Off Iran Spurs Haven Demand
top_signals.summary: The dollar rallied Monday as Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said the US will cut Iran off from the global financial system, underscoring the greenback’s central role in trade and boosting its haven appeal.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Texas Stock Exchange Lures Two ETFs From NYSE
top_signals.summary: Carlos Peña, head of ETF & funds management at Texas Capital, joins Scarlet Fu and Eric Balchunas on "ETF IQ." The Texas Stock Exchange notched its first primary listings as two small ETFs focused on the state’s economy announced plans to transfer to the upstart marketplace. The two ETFs are Texas Capital Texas Index ETF (ticker: TXS) and Texas Capital Texas Oil Index ETF (ticker: OILT).  (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
